name: Example: Sets Defined Using Trigonometric Equations
problem: List the elements of the set $A = \left\{ x\in \mathbb R \: :\:  \tan \left(\dfrac{\pi x}{2}\right) = 0  \right\}.$
worked_solution:
Notice that the solutions to the equation

$$
\tan \left(\dfrac{\pi x}{2}\right) = 0
$$

 are given by

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\pi x}{2} & =n\pi  \\ x & =2n\end{aligned}
$$

where $n\in\mathbb Z.$ 

Substituting different values of $n,$ we see that the solutions are

$$
x = 0,\, \pm 2 ,\, \pm 4,\, \pm 6,\, \ldots
$$

Therefore, our set $A$ is equivalent to 

$$
A= \{0,\, \pm 2 ,\, \pm 4,\, \pm 6,\, \ldots\}.
$$
